name: binance-futures-autobot
description: Autonomous Binance USD-M Futures Intraday Trading Bot with Auto-Scanner, Technical & Gemini AI News Sentiment Analysis, Risk Engine, Backtester, and Real-time Web Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB -c cyan,green "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=shared run build && npm --workspace=server run build && npm --workspace=web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=server run typecheck && npm --workspace=web run typecheck
